name: How long does toilet overflow cleanup typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does toilet overflow cleanup typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of toilet overflow cleanup depends on several factors, including the amount of water, the type of water (clean vs. sewage), and the affected materials. A minor overflow on a hard surface might be cleaned and dried within a few hours. However, if water has soaked into carpets, drywall, or subflooring, the drying process alone can take 3-5 days. This involves using industrial-grade dehumidifiers and air movers. Comprehensive cleanup, including sanitization and minor repairs, could extend the total timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cleanup time varies, from a few hours for minor spills on hard surfaces to 3-5 days for drying if porous materials are affected, plus additional time for sanitization and repairs.
